author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 2, Episode 5 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, hosts Frankey and Coy sit down with actor and comedian Joel Kim Booster (Loot, Fire Island, K-Pop Demon Hunters) and then The Comic Shop creator Cheyenne Ewulu for two of the most unfiltered DC conversations this season. Joel goes deep on Absolute Batman, Green Lantern Kyle Rayner, and his dream fancast as The Question, while Cheyenne breaks down her lifelong Robin obsession and building her own nerd universe with web series The Comic Shop.

Frankey and Coy also dig into Guy Gardner’s haircut, settle a game of F/M/K on the live-action Alfreds, and open up DC Dispatch to answer real fan questions. If you're a fan of DC Studios, the DC Universe, comic books, superhero storytelling, and exclusive fan access, this episode is packed with must-hear moments.

Episode Breakdown
✅ Joel Kim Booster reveals his dream DC role: a street-level, C-tier hero he's wanted to play his whole life
✅ Guy Gardner's haircut is CONFIRMED for
title: DC Studios Showcase | Season 2, Ep. 5 | Joel Kim Booster & Cheyenne Ewulu on Fandom, Batman & More

author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 1, Episode 1 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, co-hosts Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton welcome Big Bang Theory creators Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady, superhero storyteller Zak Penn, and John Ross Bowie, who returns as Barry Kripke. This is the kind of exclusive access fans dream about, including the original Stuart spinoff pitch, the secret behind Kripke’s voice, and the moment Danny Elfman sang the show’s opening credits theme into his phone.

From the behind-the-scenes leap from multi-camera sitcom to single-camera comic book chaos, to Kripke becoming a post-apocalyptic warlord in “Spoiler: Gary Dies,” Episode 1 is packed with Big Bang Theory history, superhero craft, and stories that could only come from the people who built this universe.
